remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and charm at 10 Magnolia Ave, located in the heart of Norwalk, CT. This inviting home features a thoughtful layout with three bedrooms and a beautifully tiled bathroom, providing ample space for relaxation and everyday living. Hardwood floors throughout that enhance the warmth and character of each room. The living area boasts a stunning brick fireplace, perfect for cozy evenings and adding a touch of elegance to your gatherings. For added convenience, enjoy the benefits of solar panels that not only contribute to energy efficiency but also reduce utility costs. Central air conditioning ensures comfort year-round, while a detached garage offers parking and extra storage space. Nestled in a desirable neighborhood, this residence combines modern amenities with timeless appeal. With its proximity to local amenities and easy access to major highways, 10 Magnolia Ave presents an exceptional opportunity to embrace a lifestyle of convenience and comfort in Norwalk.
